name: Defiler
about: Feeds on crowds. The more enemies around you, the faster they wither and the more you heal. Energy refills on its own.

E.name: Soul Feast
E.about: Heal yourself and the party 5 for every enemy around you (up to 12). Best in the middle of a crowd.

F.name: Life Drain
F.about: Toggle. Every enemy around you loses 1% of its life per second for each enemy in range (up to 25%), and heals the party. Swiftness on your gear drains faster; Vitality heals more.
